blocked_fraction: tasks with access other than clear / task count
bottleneck_fraction: tasks with at least ceil(n/2) strict descendants / n
branch_count: number of distinct branch equivalence classes; no branch label
customer_count: sum of disjoint group membership sizes
dag_level_width: largest longest-path-level population; not exact antichain width
dependency_overlap: mean pairwise required-task Jaccard; empty/empty defined zero
effort_missing_fraction: tasks with null effort / task count
effort_std: population SD of known task effort
effort_sum: sum of known effort; missingness separate
group_size_std: population SD of group membership size
report_customer_correlation: Pearson declared report-order / direct customer membership; constant defined zero
report_effort_correlation: Pearson declared report-order / known effort; constant defined zero
task_group_membership_max: maximum groups directly requiring a task

selection_rule: lowest mean absolute development regret; fixed retained unless strictly beaten
